Welcome to the Angelina owners’ property management hub

Thank you for buying at Angelina through LJ Hooker Nelson Bay. This page brings together our management options for your apartment, the owner-only furniture offer from Harvey Norman Port Stephens, and details about your building.

Your building

Angelina sits in the heart of Nelson Bay, overlooking Port Stephens. It is an eight-storey, architect-designed building of boutique one, two and three bedroom apartments and penthouses, with open plan living opening onto generous balconies, quality appliances and premium kitchen and bathroom fittings.

  • 56apartments

Managing your apartment

Whether you plan to lease long term or run it as a holiday rental, our local team can handle it for you. Choose an option to see what’s included.

Property management with LJ Hooker Nelson Bay & Medowie

You get your own dedicated property manager as a direct, consistent contact. Our team acts as a professional buffer between you and your tenant, keeping interactions efficient and respectful.

Download Permanent Management Brochure

What’s included

  • Tenancy documents prepared and lodged
  • Regular rental market reviews
  • Online rental payment statements
  • Routine inspections
  • Detailed condition reports with photos
  • Tenant check-in and check-out
  • Smoke alarm, water and pool compliance checks
  • Cost-effective repairs and maintenance
  • Payment of outgoings and utility transfers
  • Insurance claim processing
  • Rent collection and arrears management
  • Dispute resolution

How tenant selection works

Every applicant gets a credit check, rental history ledger review, employment and personal reference checks, and tenancy history confirmation. Only applicants who meet our criteria are presented to you.

Repairs made easy

When a tenant logs a repair in the online portal, you and our team are alerted straight away. We arrange the tradesperson at a competitive price, and tenants receive 24-hour emergency contacts.

Holiday rental management with LJ Hooker Nelson Bay

A family-owned boutique agency with over 30 years in holiday rentals, supporting owners and guests across Airbnb, Booking.com and Stayz, plus our own website, nelsonbaygetaways.com.au.

Download Holiday Management Brochure

What’s included

  • STRA registration and renewals
  • Professional photography
  • End-to-end compliance management
  • Premium linen coordination and supply
  • Professional cleaning, with app-based photo-verified checklists
  • Condition report before letting, and vacate reports
  • Booking platform and listing management
  • Guest communication, check-in and check-out
  • 24/7 emergency response
  • Online income reporting and performance tracking

Your money, clearly reported

  • Monthly statements through licensed trust accounting
  • Income comes from agreed nightly tariffs
  • Guests pay cleaning, platform and credit card fees
  • No agency income from cleaning or supplier costs
  • Live owner portal (Homhero) to view bookings
  • Stay in your own apartment any time, with no restrictions

Marketing

Your apartment is promoted on Instagram (Nelson Bay Getaways), Facebook, the LJ Hooker national network, Destination Port Stephens, our front window display and database campaigns.

Guests pay a security deposit (minimum $300, pre-authorised by card) and complete online check-in with ID verification.
